$comment: Pinned API list prices used to turn gateway-logged token counts into a cost. One dated table for every run sealed while it is current; each seal records asOf and the table's sha256, so a later price change never rewrites an earlier run's cost. To update: change the numbers, set asOf to the day you read them, add the source, and commit. Never edit a sealed run's recorded cost.

sources.openai: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing — Standard tier, flagship table (short and long context), read 2026-11-17
sources.anthropic: Anthropic's model and pricing reference (claude-api reference, models table cached 2026-11-03; cache write is 1.25x input for the 5-minute TTL and 2x for the 1-hour TTL), read 2026-11-17
sources.vercel-ai-gateway: https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models — the pricing of each model row (google/gemini-4-neon), read 2026-11-18

rules.openai: input_tokens includes cached tokens. Cached tokens are billed at cachedInput, the rest of input at input (cache-write tokens OpenAI reports are part of input and billed at input). A request whose input exceeds longContext.aboveInputTokens is billed at the longContext rates for the whole request.
rules.anthropic: input_tokens is the uncached input. cache_read_input_tokens are billed at cacheRead, cache_creation_input_tokens at cacheWrite5m unless the response splits them by TTL (cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens at cacheWrite1h). Claude Haiku 5.5 bills a prompt over 100K tokens at its longContext rates.
rules.vercel-ai-gateway: Models served through Vercel AI Gateway (omp's vercel-ai-gateway provider) are priced at the gateway's own list price, keyed by the gateway's model id (creator/model). Input is billed as the response reports it: uncached input at input, cache reads at cachedInput, cache writes at cacheWrite where the model lists one and at input otherwise.
rules.subscriptions: A run made on a subscription login (ChatGPT for Codex, a Claude subscription token) is not billed per token. Its cost is the API list-price equivalent of the tokens the gateway saw, which is what makes runs comparable.
